messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Interlingua, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Interlingua line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Postea io habeva reposate un poco mi corpore fatigate, Io reprendeva le via per le declive desertic, sic que le pede ferme esseva sempre le plus basse.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Interlingua) | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|-----------------------------------|------------------------|--------| | Poi | temporal adverb “After” | **Postea** | after | OK | | ch'èi | “that I have” (conj. + aux.) | — (omitted) | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | posato | verb “rested” (perfect) | **reposate** | rested | OK | | un | indefinite article/ numeral “a” | **un** | a | OK | | poco | adverb of quantity “little” | **poco** | little | OK | | il | definite article “the” (determiner for *corpo*) | **mi** (possessive) | my | **UNNECESSARY** | | corpo | noun “body” | **corpore** | body | OK | | lasso | adjective “weary” | **fatigate** | weary | OK | | ripresi | verb “resumed / took” (past) | **reprendeva** | resumed | OK | | via | noun “way” | **via** | way | OK | | per | preposition “along” | **per** | along | OK | | la | definite article “the” (determiner for *piaggia*) | **le** | the | OK | | piaggia | noun “slope” (archaic) | **declive** | slope | OK | | diserta | adjective “desert” (empty) | **desertic** | desert | OK | | sì | adverb/conjunction “so” (resultative) | **sic** | so | OK | | che | conjunction “that” | **que** | that | OK | | ’l | definite article “the” (for *piè*) | **le** | the | OK | | piè | noun “foot” (the firm foot) | **pede** | foot | OK | | fermo | adjective “firm” | **ferme** | firm | OK | | sempre | adverb “always” | **sempre** | always | OK | | era | verb “was” (imperfect) | **esseva** | was | OK | | ’l | definite article “the” (for *più basso*) | **le** | the | OK | | più | comparative particle “more/most” | **plus** | more/most | OK | | basso | adjective “lower” (comparative) | **basse** | lower | **GRAMMAR** |

### Items Requiring Attention
| Type | Source Word(s) | Issue | |------|----------------|-------| | **UNNECESSARY** | **ch'èi** | Conjunction + auxiliary omitted in Interlingua (temporal clause introduced by “Postea”). | | **UNNECESSARY** | **il** (article before *corpo*) | Possessive “mi” replaces the article; article not needed in Interlingua. | | **GRAMMAR** | **basse** (translation of *basso*) | In Interlingua adjectives are invariable; the comparative should be **plus basso** (or **plus basse** only if plural). The form **basse** is a gender/number inflection that does not exist in Interlingua. |
No source words are completely **MISSING** or **WRONG** in meaning; the only problems are the two unnecessary elements (which are permissible omissions) and the adjective agreement error on the final comparative.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Interlingua script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Interlingua text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 28** - Original: `Postea io habeva reposate un poco mi corpore fatigate,` - Issue: none - Corrected: `Postea io habeva reposate un poco mi corpore fatigate,`
- **Line 29** - Original: `Io reprendeva le via per le declive desertic,` - Issue: none - Corrected: `Io reprendeva le via per le declive desertic,`
- **Line 30** - Original: `sic que le pede ferme esseva sempre le plus basse.` - Issue: **GRAMMAR** – comparative adjective should be invariant; use “plus basso”. - Corrected: `sic que le pede ferme esseva sempre le plus basso.`
